label: megathrust, lower reach creeping
blurb: The same thrust, 200 km long, slipping in the plate only. Its lower reach, from 30 to 45 km, is a fault that resists its slip rate: it is locked in the earthquake and slips afterwards.

unit.rate: MPa per metre of slip, per Maxwell time
